The reported "muddy" taste before onset is a gustatory aura, which localizes to the temporal lobe (often mesial temporal structures). Witnessed automatisms and postictal lethargy further support epileptic seizures. The EEG shows interictal spikes/sharp waves localized to the temporal lobes, greater on the right, corroborating a temporal-lobe epileptic focus. Brain MRI is normal, which is common in nonlesional focal (temporal) epilepsy. Together, the clinical semiology and EEG findings point to focal (temporal lobe) epilepsy with impaired awareness seizures originating from the right temporal lobe.

DIAGNOSIS: Focal epilepsy — focal seizures with impaired awareness (right temporal lobe epilepsy).
